name: Moi International Airport
before:
The coast airport, and the one that matters for a Kenyan beach holiday. Mombasa is the country's second city and this is its gateway, 425 km south east of Nairobi by air, which makes a safari and beach twin centre straightforward to build.

Three terminals split the work cleanly. Terminal 1 takes international services and holds immigration, customs, duty free and baggage handling. Terminal 2 handles domestic flights, and a separate general aviation terminal deals with private and charter traffic. For clients connecting from a bush strip onto an international departure, that separation is worth knowing about.

Two runways serve it, the longer at 3,350 metres with an instrument landing system fitted, the shorter at 1,260 metres.

Airports Council International named it the best airport in Africa in its size category in 2020, which for a facility of this scale says something about how it is run.
after:
Mombasa's airport on the Kenyan coast, and the one that matters for a beach holiday there. Jambojet puts the flight from Nairobi at about an hour, which makes a safari and beach twin centre straightforward to build.

Three terminals split the work. Terminal 1 takes international services and Terminal 2 domestic flights, while a separate general aviation terminal deals with private and charter traffic. For clients connecting from a bush strip onto an international departure, that separation is worth knowing about.

Two runways serve it, the longer at 3,350 metres.

Airports Council International named it Africa's best airport with under 2 million passengers a year in 2021 and 2022, and one of the best in 2023.

claims.note: Was 'the best airport in Africa in its size category in 2020' (Wikipedia). ACI's own list of past customer experience award winners begins at 2021: it names Moi alone in Africa's under 2 million category in 2021 and 2022, and with Zanzibar and Antananarivo in 2023; Moi is not in the 2024 list. The text gives ACI's years; whether Wikipedia's 2020 is the same award counted by another year could not be settled from ACI's page.
